sentences.en: Lack of sleep is detrimental to your health.
sentences.zh: 缺乏睡眠对你的健康不利。

sentences.en: Mathematics is not detrimental to the appetite.
Tom's stressful job is having a detrimental effect on his health.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的工作压力对他健康产生了不良影响。

senses.zh: 有害的人（或物）；不受欢迎的求婚者

mnemonic: 词根记忆：detriment（损害，伤害）+ al（…的）→损害的
